limits: No goods, workers, construction or money are granted in a live game. All static layouts require the full stated capital beforehand.
No actual terrain/roads, logistics latency, population migration/departure, happiness transition or source diversity is simulated.
All output is ideal full-capacity where feasible. Scenarios with shortages identify deficits; full-supply revenues are explicitly upper bounds.
Maintenance is charged for every built facility even when jobs or raw materials are missing.
Per-person clothes/pottery income applies once per actual final demand; tea services are capped by distinct residents, never duplicated across buildings.
